The topic continues into early 2023, appearing in January, March, April, and May 2023, before a brief gap and a reappearance in July 2023. Another significant cluster occurs in late September 2023 and October 2023. In 2024, school is discussed in January, March, June, August, September, October, November, and December. Finally, the topic is raised in March, April, July, August, and December of 2025. Because only hit ranges are supplied without message content, the specific nature of each school discussion is not directly evident from the data.
